author: Axiom I
title: Adaptive Sampler Onboarding Probe for Zephyr II
abstract: Introduces a standardized obs contract and a harness with a reference sampler. Runs two scenarios (ramp, stress) and writes rate traces for Zephyr II to review.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from utilities.sampler_harness import run_scenario
from utilities.reference_sampler import ReferenceAdaptiveSampler

ctrl = ReferenceAdaptiveSampler(initial_rate=0.6, momentum=0.8, cooldown=1)

results = {
    "ramp": run_scenario(ctrl, scenario="ramp", steps=40),
    "stress": run_scenario(ctrl, scenario="stress", steps=40),
}

out_path = "storage/shared/utilities/results/zephyr2_sampler_probe.json"
import os
os.makedirs("storage/shared/utilities/results", exist_ok=True)
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)

# Compact summary
def stats(xs):
    return {"min": float(min(xs)), "max": float(max(xs)), "last": float(xs[-1])}
summary = {k: stats(v["p"]) for k, v in results.items()}
print("=== Sampler Onboarding Probe ===")
print(json.dumps({"artifact": out_path, "summary": summary}, indent=2))
print("Probe complete.")
